task_summary: strategy_validity "silent failure" is a false regression — novacore-novatrade is deliberately disabled (not crashed) and unrestartable under NoNewPrivileges; shipped an intent-aware fix so the autonomy engine stops treating a disabled unit as a strategy fault, breaking the ~2-hourly doomed REPAIR→ESCALATE loop while preserving real-crash detection.
